agent.workflow.replaces: It replaces the workflow saved under this name.
agent.workflow.mayReplace: If a workflow already has this name, this replaces it.
agent.workflow.oddBlank: {{text}} (nothing to see: it is empty or only spaces)
agent.workflow.oddEdge: {{text}} (a space at its start or end)
agent.workflow.together: When more than one next step applies, they run side by side, as many at once as the definition below allows.
agent.workflow.goesOn: A failure here doesn't stop the run.
agent.workflow.unreached: A run never reaches this step.
agent.workflow.noQuestion: It asks in the agent's standard words.
agent.workflow.askBackground: In a background run nobody is asked, and it goes on to the steps under Otherwise.
agent.workflow.askBackgroundFails: In a background run nobody is asked, and the run fails here.
agent.workflow.input: It gets this as its input:
agent.workflow.whole: The definition below is what gets saved, every setting included. A value shown as [REDACTED] or [hidden] is kept off this card and saved as written.
agent.workflow.more: Steps not shown here: {{n}}. They are in the definition below.
agent.workflow.step.foreach: Runs the workflow {{arg}} for each item
agent.asWritten: This holds characters a screen would hide or change. It is shown as written, each one marked, like ⟨ESC⟩ or ⟨U+200B⟩: this exact text is what runs.
agent.asWrittenSeen: I have read the exact text, marks included
agent.asWrittenBlind: This holds characters a screen would hide or change, and part of it can't be shown here (a key is hidden in it, or it is too long). It can't be allowed from this page: deny it, or decide in the Agent.
agent.longShown: This is longer than the card usually shows, so it is shown whole here. Read all of it before you allow it.
agent.longSeen: I have read all of it
agent.cutMore: {{n}} more characters are not shown here.
agent.longBlind: This is too long to show here in full. It can't be allowed from this page: deny it, or decide in the Agent.
agent.attach: Add images (up to 4, 4 MB each) or text files (up to 24 KB)
agent.continueInAgent: Continue this in the Agent app
agent.d.elsewhere: Decided in another tab or app
agent.decisionUnknown: Your answer may have gone through
agent.gateHeldFull: Earlier decisions are still going through. You can answer this once they do.
agent.linkBlocked: (Not linked: opening this address could run something.)
agent.slashEmptyOnly: A command starts an empty message
agent.slashHold: Sends once this computer's commands are read, in a few seconds at most: a message that starts with "/" may be one of them.
agent.shot.desc: A picture of this chat's computer screen
agent.shot.noComputer: This chat's computer isn't shown here
agent.shot.full_one: This message already has its {{max}} image
agent.shot.capturing: Taking a screenshot of display {{n}} on {{computer}}…
agent.shot.none: No display is running on {{computer}}, so no screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.gone: Display {{n}} on {{computer}} isn't running any more. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.unreachable: {{computer}} didn't answer. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.private: This session can't reach the displays of {{computer}}. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.lost: This chat's computer is no longer shown here. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.framed: Screenshots can't be taken while the Hub is shown inside another page. Open the Hub in its own tab.
agent.shot.tooBig: The screenshot of display {{n}} is too large. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.notImage: Display {{n}} didn't answer with a picture. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.listFailed: The displays of {{computer}} couldn't be read. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.failed: Display {{n}} on {{computer}} couldn't be captured. No screenshot was attached.
agent.shot.pick.title: Screenshot of a display
agent.shot.pick.body: Nothing is sent until you press Send. {{computer}} keeps its own copy of each screenshot.
agent.shot.pick.label: Display on {{computer}}
agent.slashFailed: This computer's skills could not be read. Only the built-in commands show.
agent.mentionFailed: This folder could not be read.
agent.mentionHidden: Only hidden files here. Type a dot to list them.
agent.coversSession: Allow once and Deny apply to this call only.
agent.helperAsked: Asked by helper "{{name}}". Approving applies to this one call only.
agent.helperAskedAnon: Asked by a helper. Approving applies to this one call only.
agent.lost.allow: We lost the answer to your Allow. The approval is no longer waiting, which does not tell us what happened.
agent.lost.deny: We lost the answer to your Deny. The approval is no longer waiting, which does not tell us what happened.
agent.lost.decision: We lost the answer to your decision. The approval is no longer waiting, which does not tell us what happened.
agent.lost.answer: We lost your answer. The question is no longer waiting, which does not tell us what happened.
result.reviewName: Review the {{n}} changed files in Details
agent.gateArming: Keys wait a moment here, so a key already on its way can't answer this.
